sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully implements the verified direct-static requirement: applicability is determined by the required sewageDischargeType value, the non-applicable alternative is explicitly restricted to a different present value, and the applicable branch preserves MARPOL compliance, the strict distance threshold, both ice-concentration constraints, and the recorded distance in the canonical units. Deterministic validation is valid; freeze the graph.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional logic: the non-applicable branch currently permits any sewageDischargeType when comminutedAndDisinfected=false, creating an accidental pass and an invented alternative applicability test. Base applicability on the required sewageDischargeType value, and do not duplicate or contradict that fact with a separate boolean branch.
